turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
l return?

Hi — yes, a damaged item is handled differently from a standard return 🙂

If your item arrived damaged:

simplemodern.com or another retailer: use our claims portal at https://claims.simplemodern.com
Amazon: Amazon handles delivery damage directly, so you’d need to contact Amazon customer service

A normal return is for unused, non-defective items and goes through our return process instead.

Where did you purchase it — simplemodern.com, Amazon, or another retailer?

turns.q: What if more than one item in my order is affected?
turns.replyTail:
Hi — if more than one item in your order arrived damaged, that’s okay 🙂

You’ll just want to:

include photos of each damaged item
note which specific items in the order were affected
submit everything through our claims portal: https://claims.simplemodern.com

If you’re sending info here first, please make sure to list which items are damaged so the claim can be reviewed correctly.
